review_scope: Independent manual review of final Document, Artifact prompt and manifest against explicit typed role plus supplied source observations. This is not actual-media perception or generated-video quality verification.

cases.requirement: Reference source identifies the generated subject; the showroom must not be copied merely from a subject-only role.
cases.reason: Final subject is source black sports car/carbon-fibre identity attributed to asset-1 visual identity; a new featureless dark void is explicitly creative rather than copied showroom. Prompt preserves caller forward motion, no dialogue, and one bound picture identity.

checks.reason: Source identity/render likeness is not independently measurable without output video.

cases.requirement: Reference source supplies the showroom environment; source car identity is not independently licensed as a subject reference.
cases.reason: Only the empty showroom floor is sourced as environment/scene from asset-1. Generic dark saloon is a creative/caller target, without imported sports-car/carbon-fibre identity. Detailed floor slabs/columns and generated sound are creative, no dialogue or extra source track.

checks.reason: Exact showroom geometry/pixels remain not_evaluable from the supplied summary card.

cases.requirement: Reference source supplies visual presentation; source car identity and showroom location are not independently licensed by the style role.
cases.reason: Target is generic caller car with unspecified make/model/color; visual style reference is weak_reference only. No source sports-car/carbon-fibre or showroom content enters final prose or creative claims. Manifest role style and no vocal performance.

checks.reason: The card supplies live-action cinematic style only; pixel/lighting style resemblance is not evaluated.

cases.requirement: Video supplies temporal/motion/composition guidance without independently importing source identity, scenery, or its audio track.
cases.reason: Source video is weak reference for camera/cut structure only; target generic car and empty pavement do not import tunnel, source actor identity or source audio. Manifest visual-only structure role, no dialogue.

checks.reason: The supplied partial card has no observed camera/cut timing; exact temporal resemblance cannot be evaluated.

cases.requirement: Image supplies shot/composition guidance without independently importing subject identity, scenery, or speech.
cases.reason: Weak storyboard reference supplies viewpoint/placement/order; generic passenger-car appearance and empty dark setting are expressly creative. No showroom/carbon source content, no reference signal, no speech.

checks.reason: Composition is unknown in the supplied card, so exact layout resemblance cannot be evaluated.

cases.requirement: First-frame source must be bound as an exact starting anchor at zero; its pose/framing may be retained through that license.
cases.reason: i2va/first_frame socket and role, fully_preserved anchor0. Opening prose/event explicitly hold complete supplied black carbon-fibre car/showroom frame before new movement; no crop, panel loss or speech.

checks.reason: Pixel-exact anchor preservation belongs to downstream video rendering and is not evaluated.

cases.requirement: Last-frame source must be bound as an exact ending anchor at the generated end; its pose/framing may be retained through that license.
cases.reason: l2va/last_frame socket and role, fully_preserved anchor5000 at target endpoint. Final narrative explicitly aligns complete source layout, subject placement, lighting and background; source car/showroom are authorized by full-frame licence, no speech.

checks.reason: Pixel-exact endpoint preservation belongs to downstream video rendering and is not evaluated.

cases.requirement: Source video is the explicitly edited base; source visual continuity may be retained, but source audio is not automatically copied.
cases.reason: Final subject/reference use asset-1 visual edit_source fully_preserved; prompt explicitly edits the source car/tunnel and keeps its continuous forward movement. New soundscape is marked newly generated; no source audio channel or dialogue is copied.

checks.reason: Only three sampled frames of source video are supplied, so preservation over unseen intervals remains not_evaluable.

cases.requirement: Source video is the continuation base; continuation must follow source motion/scene rather than reinterpret the clip as mere style.
cases.reason: Final source identity and tunnel are continued with continuation_source/partially_preserved, not style. Source left-to-right motion is explicitly retained in shot2; new tunnel-light details and score are creative. Soundscape expressly generated, with no copied audio or dialogue.

checks.reason: The three-frame partial card has no precise final frame; exact seamless terminal-state continuation remains not_evaluable.

cases.requirement: Audio supplies only voice character, not transcript or new dialogue; a speech-free car request must not invent speech solely to use the asset.
cases.reason: No speech is invented and the dormant voice metadata itself is valid. However, final shot prose, sound event and soundscape explicitly use the voice-timbre reference to shape a newly generated mechanical engine rumble (with its timbre shaped by the supplied audio reference). That crosses the declared voice-only property into sound-texture guidance. The manifest role remains voice, so its correct label does not repair the unauthorized audible use.

checks.reason: Actual voice/waveform fidelity remains not_evaluable; the unsupported role transfer is visible in the published text itself.

cases.requirement: Audio is the declared background track reference; it must not become dialogue, voice character or visual identity.
cases.reason: Original asset-1 audio is explicitly partially copied as the background-music bed across all three shots. Prompt/soundscape retain no dialogue/extra voice; the rumble reference is not reinterpreted as vocal timbre or mere stylistic guidance. Manifest music/partially_copy matches final music.

checks.reason: Actual three-second-to-five-second signal mix/extension is downstream and not evaluable.

cases.requirement: Audio supplies music-style characteristics; no permission to copy exact source audio or invent dialogue follows.
cases.reason: Final music is a newly generated low-frequency score following declared musical style/instrumentation/tempo, explicitly without original signal copying. The separate creative engine sound is not said to use the reference as a sound-effect property. Manifest music_style/reference, no dialogue.

checks.reason: The supplied rumble card establishes no measured musical style/tempo, so actual acoustic fidelity cannot be evaluated.

cases.requirement: Audio supplies timing/rhythm guidance; no permission to copy exact source audio or invent dialogue follows.
cases.reason: Audio is beat_reference/reference for timing of cuts and action, not copied signal. Two shots and timed ignition/forward motion are guided by the declared rhythm; engine is newly generated, without explicit transfer of source voice/music/texture properties or speech.

checks.reason: The rumble card has no measured beats; exact acoustic/beat synchronization is not evaluable.

cases.requirement: Audio supplies sound-effect reference; no permission to reinterpret it as dialogue or musical identity follows.
cases.reason: Audio is sfx/reference and final soundscape explicitly generates new engine texture from its allowed texture property without copying signal. Generic car remains user target, music absent, no voice or speech.

checks.reason: Actual waveform/texture resemblance is not evaluable from characterisation alone.

cases.requirement: Incoming driver in red must be added using asset-1 while the edited base asset-2 retains its own driver, car and tunnel; placement must not silently replace an existing identity.
cases.reason: New red-jacket driver from asset1/placed_subject is visibly added at wheel while original grey-overall driver from asset2 crosses left-to-right; both remain distinct. Base black/carbon car and tunnel/sodium scene remain, source-picture showroom/pose excluded. New sounds are creative, no speech; no replacement-motion obligation is required for additive placement.

checks.reason: Partial source video cannot establish continuous staging/timing or pixel likeness over unseen intervals.

cases.requirement: Incoming driver in red must replace the explicitly targeted original driver, retaining the base car/tunnel and inherited motion; the replacement must not duplicate or preserve the replaced driver identity.
cases.reason: Red-jacket incoming identity replaces resolved original driver; original is attribute_transfer/taken_over_by with grey-overall appearance removed. Red driver actually walks inherited left-to-right path, supported by source2 motion obligation. Base carbon car/tunnel/sodium scene remain; picture backdrop/pose and source soundtrack are not copied, no speech.

checks.reason: Only partial sampled source motion is available, so exact continuous motion/timing and pixel likeness are not evaluable.

scope_limit: Role contract review against typed supplied observations only; actual media/generation fidelity remains not_evaluable per check. The voice-timbre recipient failure is independent of the run formal operation gates.
